note: Raw Phase 1 extraction layer. Machine-readable; carries the same records as _exports/phase1/json/iic_corpus.json plus the quote vault and academic evidence, with no interpretation added. Regenerated - do not hand-edit.

evidence_tiers.T1: Primary - the origin of the fact. Government publications and official statistics, official portals, statutes and tenders, official vendor pricing pages, and documents an institution publishes about itself (its own IIC annual report, its own submitted NIRF/ARIIA form). Use for market sizing, compliance claims and pricing.
evidence_tiers.T2: High-quality secondary - reputable analysis of primary data. Peer-reviewed academic work, IIM/IIIT research, established consulting, World Bank/OECD. Use for framing and triangulation, never as the sole support for a number in the pitch.
evidence_tiers.T3: Market intelligence - commercially motivated. Tracxn, Crunchbase, Factly/Dataful, SaaS directories. Never for market size.
evidence_tiers.T4: Community - anecdotal. Vendor case studies, vendor blogs, LinkedIn, Reddit, review-site excerpts. Sentiment and discovery only; never any number.

parse_status_vocabulary.parsed: Document retrieved and the cited metrics were read directly from its text.
parse_status_vocabulary.partial: Document retrieved; some sections read, others still to be extracted.
parse_status_vocabulary.header_only: Document located and identified, but KPI tables not yet read.
parse_status_vocabulary.unparseable: Retrieved but text could not be extracted (scanned image, corrupt, login-gated).
parse_status_vocabulary.access_denied: URL reachable but content is behind auth, paywall, or removed.

academic_evidence.citation: Srihari, P. & Mathew, T. 'Analysis and Design of an Institution's Intellectual Property Management System' / TTO practice study, IISc. PICMET 2014 proceedings.
academic_evidence.finding: Analysed 382 patent records. Demonstrates that poor data cleaning and record-keeping in a university TTO has legal and commercialisation consequences, not merely administrative ones.
academic_evidence.use_for: Establishes that IP record-keeping defects are a commercial risk, not a clerical one.

academic_evidence.citation: ICAR-NAARM patent-management literature (agricultural university TTO practice).
academic_evidence.finding: Documents that missed prosecution deadlines result in abandoned applications - i.e. the cost of a missing date field is the entire patent.
academic_evidence.use_for: Quantifies the downside of deadline tracking that no observed system performs.

academic_evidence.citation: JIPR (Journal of Intellectual Property Research & Practice), 2026.
academic_evidence.finding: Evidence that faculty file patents independently of their institution, which prevents the institution claiming NIRF/ARIIA credit for work that happened on its campus.
academic_evidence.use_for: Explains a root cause of the NIRF/IP data gap: the invention leaves before the record does.
